message: The other day, I found myself in the kitchen making dinner, and I suddenly remembered a fire safety tip from my childhood—that the best fire escape plan is the one you practice. So, I called the kids in and we turned it into a little game, pretending to be firefighters! It reminded me that sometimes the simplest activities can teach us important lessons while also being a blast. Have you ever turned safety practices into a family fun time? I'd love to hear your ideas!
